content.short: On-demand stablecoin liquidity so payment companies can pay out without prefunding accounts.
content.description: Cross-border payment firms normally park cash in accounts in every country they serve. MANSA replaces that with stablecoin capital that arrives at the moment of settlement, and handles collections, payouts, FX and treasury through one API. It covers more than 40 corridors, including naira to renminbi routes, and has moved over $664 million in stablecoin volume. It is backed by Tether.
content.meta: MANSA supplies stablecoin capital at settlement time so PSPs stop prefunding, with payouts and FX in 40+ corridors.
